blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: procedure — A subroutine that performs actions and does not return a result.
function — A subroutine that returns a value.
parameter — A named input in the subroutine declaration.
argument — The actual value provided by the caller.
return — Finish a function and pass its result to the caller.

blocks.title: CALL
blocks.text: The caller supplies argument 6 to Double.

blocks.title: PARAMETER
blocks.text: Parameter value receives 6, then value * 2 evaluates to 12.

blocks.title: RETURN
blocks.text: The function returns 12. Console.WriteLine displays the result.
